# The Exchange copy guard forwards its status variable, not a returned expression

GuardCopyServiceListener captures rv by reference and reports that value when its local guard exits. The accepted local-delete callback assigns LocalDeleteMessages into rv before exit. A direct return expression alone does not update that separate variable: the original EWS callback initialized rv to NS_OK and then directly returned local deletion. PromiseCopyListener rejects non-NS_OK onStopCopy, so forwarded status is part of the test completion contract. This does not prove all remote-error paths settle or that each listener is called exactly once. No operation was executed.

Scope: Exchange copy-listener status and completion.
